about_the_game:
A real treat for super fans of Azur Lane, this free DLC will unlock a very special mission indeed. By completing it, not only will you unlock an individually-voiced Commander from the universe of Azur Lane, but you’ll also get a Premium cruiser inspired by the very same Commander—Avrora!

This package includes:

  • 1x combat mission | Conditions: Finish five battles of any type except Training Battles | Rewards: Soviet Tier III Premium cruiser AL Avrora plus Commander Avrora with an individual voiceover and 3 skill points, trained for AL Avrora.

  • 1x Azur Lane container

This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available until July 2, 2025.
